purpose: Retain a reproducible trait x present-environment exploratory diagnostic for the focal radiation without making it a primary Chapter 2 axis or a required manuscript result.

trait_universe.role: available image-derived continuous traits for internal exploratory screening, not the complete or mandatory manuscript trait universe

environment_panel.boundary: This is one broad abiotic diagnostic panel rather than a complete causal universe. The spatial-breadth axis is defined independently of these predictors.

analysis_layers.primary_output: complete trait x environment table with effect, raw P, BH q, coverage and leave-one-taxon-out direction
phylogeny/topology sensitivity for the complete diagnostic table
analysis_layers.selection: diagnostic only; does not determine manuscript entry

current_phase1_gate.statistic: Spearman rho on taxon medians with exact taxon-label permutation and leave-one-taxon-out sign envelope
current_phase1_gate.role: frozen small-n diagnostic retained for reproducibility

manuscript_role: optional; may remain entirely outside final Results, figures and abstract
claim_boundary: This diagnostic does not define the Chapter 2 spatial-breadth axis.
An association does not establish adaptation, selection, mechanism or historical causation.
Unsupported and low-coverage rows remain visible rather than being selected away.
Missing evidence remains not_evaluable rather than biological zero.
